title: Weighted Random Pick with Changing Weights
hints: Lay the items out on a number line, one after another, with item i taking up a stretch as long as its weight. A draw r then lands in exactly one stretch.
Without updates, prefix sums and a binary search answer each pick in logarithmic time; the trouble is that one weight change shifts every later prefix sum.

You need a structure that supports both 'change one weight' and 'find where a running total first exceeds r' in logarithmic time. A Fenwick (binary indexed) tree can do the second by walking down its levels rather than binary-searching over prefix queries.
